agents.name: Atlas
agents.systemPrompt: You are Atlas, a senior software engineer. You write small, readable diffs and explain trade-offs before recommending one.

jobs.description: Nightly verification of the checked-out mem20 repo: plan the check, run the read-only git status check in the working directory, write up what changed. The command runs only from the job allowlist, with no shell.
jobs.name: Nightly repo check

stages.expectedOutput: A check plan: the checks to run and what each one proves.
stages.prompt: Plan tonight’s repo check: given the repo’s recent history, what should be verified — uncommitted changes, recent commits, and anything that looks unfinished? List the checks and what each one would prove.

stages.expectedOutput: The exact output of the read-only git status check.
stages.prompt: Run the allowlisted repo check in the working directory (git status) and report its exact output. Do not run anything else, and do not modify the repo.

stages.expectedOutput: A short report: changes, unfinished work, and decisions needed.
stages.prompt: Write the nightly repo-check report from the design plan and the command output: what changed, what is unfinished, and what needs a human decision. Quote the command output; do not invent findings.
